title: NamedQuery
description: A server-defined query in config/named_queries/ with one spelling per supported query language. The server renders the spelling the request selects and compiles it with the matching frontend. Each file name must match its name field.

name.description: Stable identifier clients invoke. Must match the YAML file stem.

description.description: One-sentence, introspection-facing summary of what the query returns.

default.description: When true, this query leads the catalog returned by ListNamedQueries so clients can preselect it. At most one query may set this.

bindings.description: Trusted server values, never client-supplied. The query uses binding("name").

schema.description: JSON Schema the client-supplied value must satisfy at render time.

example.description: Representative value substituted for test-time compilation against the ontology. Must satisfy schema.

parameters.description: Client values validated against JSON Schema. The query uses param("name") for encoded literals, identifier("name") for validated identifiers, and integer("name") for decimal Int64 IDs.

settings.description: ClickHouse settings sent with the base query, as is. Settings in the compiled SQL take precedence.

gql.description: Trusted GQL text with MiniJinja lookup expressions. Authors must place each lookup at a complete literal or identifier position outside quotes, backticks, and comments, without removing its encoding.

query.description: One spelling per supported query language, keyed by language. The server renders the spelling the request selects.
